tools.name: search_signals
tools.description: Find companies in Europe and the Americas (US, CA, BR, MX) with fresh buying signals: started hiring in a function (e.g. first SDRs), hiring spikes, leadership roles, funding, acquisitions, product launches, expansions, partnerships, milestones, layoffs, revenue jumps, turning profitable, director c

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Public Evolc profile of one company by its Evolc slug or its website domain: description, industry, size, founded year, open jobs, highlights with evidence, filed financials (newest first), public-sector customers and suppliers from the SK/CZ contract registers, and sources. No people or contact det

tools.name: check_accounts
tools.description: Check a list of known companies (e.g. the user's CRM accounts or target list, up to 100 per call): which are hiring, raised money or grew in the window, and which are quiet. Matching is exact by domain (website URL or e-mail address at the company also works), else by name within a country, else by

tools.name: search_moves
tools.description: The moves feed: what companies just did, worldwide (Europe first, US tech press since 2026-11-08), newest first — raised money, bought or merged (both sides when known), launched a product, entered a market or won a major customer, announced a partnership, stated a milestone (ARR, customers, IPO) or

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Open calls for tenders from public buyers across Europe (TED, the EU tenders journal), closing soonest first. Each tender has the buyer, category (CPV), estimated value, deadline and fit_count: how many Evolc companies won public tenders in the same CPV class since 2024. Pass company (an Evolc slug)

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: Lists saved Signals searches for the connected account, including their filters, cadence, alert state, and Evolc link.
